cohort: The participants were 1,870 parturients who received obstetric anaesthesia services at the University College Hospital, Ibadan over a two-year period.
finding: Subarachnoid block was the predominant anaesthetic technique (92.4%) for obstetric procedures, primarily caesarean deliveries (93.3%), with minimal use of labour epidural analgesia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from anaesthesia records covering a two-year period.
